subject: Updated distance sampling R packages now on CRAN

messages.author: 350dad0a615d36db
messages.subject: Updated distance sampling R packages now on CRAN
parts:
Hi listfolk,

Updated versions of the mrds, Distance and dsm R packages are now
available on CRAN. Release notes for each are available at:

https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/mrds/releases/tag/CRAN-2.1.14

https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/Distance/releases/tag/CRAN-0.9.4

https://github.com/DistanceDevelopment/dsm/releases/tag/CRAN-2.2.9

respectively.

Note that thanks to an error pointed out by Phil Bouchet on this list,
the data in the dsm packages (Gulf of Mexico pantropical spotted
dolphins) has been updated to include corrected areas for prediction
cells and segments. This has also been reflected in the DSM vignette on
distancesampling.org which you can find at
http://distancesampling.org/R/vignettes/mexico-analysis.html

These releases of mrds and dsm will become a part of the upcoming beta
release of Distance 7 (for Windows).


All the best,
--dave
